title: Logo usage
slide_intent: Teach designers to decide whether the mark leads or signs a message. A deliberate size difference lets a viewer tell what to read first.
strategic_value: The same Bolt mark can dominate a street poster or credit a headline-led communication without competing with the words.
demonstration: One example places a large mark below a short line on an outdoor ad. The second gives most of a dark field to a multiline headline and signs it with a much smaller mark.
practical_value: Choose the dominant element before sizing the logo. Compare the intended use with the primary and secondary examples on this page.
